title: Formalization of Iwasawa Theory in Lean
abstract: A formal proof of Iwasawa's classical class-number growth theorem. For an increasing tower of finite cyclic Galois extensions K_n/K of a number field with degrees p^n, the p-adic multiplicity of the class number of K_n equals mu*p^n + lambda*n + nu for all sufficiently large n, with natural mu and lambda and integer nu. The compared statement uses only Mathlib concepts. Its proof constructs the union as a Z_p-extension and discharges the Hilbert class field inputs using the external Nyll class field theory library. The library also contains the cyclotomic specialization. This formalizes a known theorem and makes no claim of a new mathematical result.
